verdict.rationale: Lithic is an API-first card-issuing platform. Its sandbox mirrors production and offers simulation endpoints, so cards, transactions and webhooks can be run end-to-end programmatically without a UI, which supports headless automated testing. However, nothing documents CI pipelines or a headless runner specifically. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g. pipeline examples, credential handling for CI), an official CLI or headless tooling, independent hands-on corroboration of automated CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: A safe environment mirroring production — run cards, transactions, and webhooks end-to-end.
The sandbox environment has additional endpoints to simulate transaction events originating from a merchant acquirer.
Simulate an authorization request from the payment network as if it came from a merchant acquirer.
